cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Shale & E&P lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +5.78%; weakest is Shale & E&P at -1.01%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: ARRY is the standout at +10.39%
cards.body: Leaders: ARRY +10.39%, BE +9.82%, EOSE +7.39%, TLN +7.33%, ETN +7.22%. Laggards: FANG -2.30%, MPC -1.98%, APA -1.74%, COP -1.47%.
